name: Rotorua Lakes Council
story: John Arnerich’s 2025 account of Locus identifies Rotorua Lakes and Greg Bennett as early supporters of FME in New Zealand. The retrospective connects the council with the early adoption of geographic data conversion and integration tools; it supplies no precise date for that first support.
